summary: Whether you’re designing a timeless sanctuary or a modern minimalist retreat, Studio Bagno’s Signature Collections provide a seamless path to achieve a cohesive, beautifully crafted bathroom.
title: Effortless Bathroom Design With Sb Collections
bodyHtml:
SB Signature Collections

Take the guesswork out of bathroom styling with Studio Bagno’s carefully curated collections. Each range is thoughtfully assembled to provide a cohesive and effortlessly designed solution across basins, toilets, baths and more.

Our collections offer a complete resource, giving you everything needed to create beautifully unified spaces with the perfect balance of quality, style, and functionality.

Collection Soul

Soul celebrates lasting design with gracefully curved lines and soft, refined forms. This collection exudes a sense of elegance that remains timeless, making it perfect for those seeking a sophisticated aesthetic.

Collection Federation

Embrace classic style with Federation’s selection of iconic federation-style baths, consoles, meticulously crafted toilets, and classic inset basins. This collection redefines traditional elegance for modern spaces.

Collection Spy

Spy is designed for the modern smaller bathroom. With stylish and functional basins, toilets, and baths, this collection brings high-end design to small spaces without compromise.

Collection Organic

Organic offers minimalist furnishings with it’s signature floating aesthetic. From bench-mounted basins to rimless toilets and freestanding baths, this collection embodies refined simplicity and elegance.

Collection Decus

The Decus Collection combines Italian style with functionality for smaller spaces. Designed with a purposeful approach, Decus provides a jaw-dropping aesthetic in a compact package.
